name: module-scope mutable state in handlers, store and methods

diagnostics.message: components/card: module-scope 'let clickCount' in .handlers.js is shared by every instance of the component. Keep per-instance values in the component's store state and change them through store actions; pass long-lived collaborators in through deps from the setup file.
